name: stat
title: Number with a bar chart
shows: A dashboard card: a label and a period, one big number with its change, and 14 daily bars (the last in the accent). The bars fall back to the period before and rise to this one; the number stays on this period, so it matches the copy beside it. With opts.window the bars are cut out of the card, so the effect ground shows through them.
place: at-corner or at-right, cut by the bottom edge; with opts.window, set the panel's vignette off (--calm-k: 0%) so the ground stays bright in the bars
edit: The number and labels are HTML (the number stays as written). data-values and data-prev (comma lists) or opts.data and opts.prev set the bars; opts.window cuts them out of the panel; opts.fill takes the fragment's height.
loop: about 2.9 s a cycle: the bars sink to the period before and rise to this one; the finished picture holds for at most 15% of the cycle; restarts when the pointer enters its card
